ag_news_document_text_category_classification_test.csv   (  7600 rows)

  Source: the AG News topic corpus, via Hugging Face fancyzhx/ag_news.
  Columns: text, category, word_count
  4 balanced categories (World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech). Real news
  headline+description pairs, NOT synthetic. These documents are SHORT --
  median 37 words, max 177 -- so a truncation sweep saturates early here.
  Integer labels 0..3 have been mapped to their names; text is
  whitespace-normalized. Official split; do not re-split across it.

  Both corpora are plain CSV: read with pandas.read_csv(path). They are
  already on local disk -- no download, no network, no `datasets` library.
